# Austenite Supplements

Austenite Supplements is a Sri Lankan online supplement shop offering authentic UK-imported Applied Nutrition products, including creatine, protein, pre-workout, vitamins and wellness supplements.

- [Privacy policy](https://austenitesupplements.uk/privacy)
- [Sitemap](https://austenitesupplements.uk/sitemap.xml)

## Product information

Product names, descriptions, prices, flavour availability and stock status are published on the shop page. Customers place orders through WhatsApp, where delivery charges and final availability are confirmed.
